params.name: Garrow Bustard
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/bustard.mjs (edit that, not this). A two-seat mini VTOL built like a muscle car: square and wide, a blunt nose that is one grille with four lamps in it over a steel bumper, a flat bonnet with a scoop through it, twin stripes nose to tail, a short strip of glass over a high waist, scissor doors, a lip spoiler, one tail light bar side to side, weld beads left showing, the biggest fans in the class in square-shouldered housings, a pusher in the tail panel and three feet with mag-lock pucks. 4.7 m long. docs/proposals/hover-cars.md.

parts.name: body
parts.note: The shell. The glass is the loft's own faces, glazed (cabin-bustard.js). The grille, the scoop, the stripes, the weld beads and the lamps are separate parts laid a hair proud of it.
